findings.issue: Same as c00446 flashLoan: the temporaries _9/_14/_5 equal mem[64] but are not identified with it, so the accumulated length and the return value keep '- mem[64]' terms, and a dead zero store precedes the address store.
findings.rule: After '_t = mem[64]', mem[64] reads as _t until the next store to mem[64]; drop a store overwritten at the same address before any read.
